normative_extracts.spec_section: Hydrating server-rendered HTML & Recovering from errors
normative_extracts.quote: If a hydration mismatch occurs inside a Suspense boundary, React discards the server HTML inside that boundary and re-renders it on the client.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: A DOM cursor walks server-rendered nodes alongside virtual tree execution; any structural divergence aborts hydration up to the nearest Suspense boundary and falls back to client DOM creation.

production_failures.symptom: Flash of unstyled content and 300 ms INP spike right after page load
production_failures.root_cause: Rendering timezone-dependent dates during SSR causes a hydration mismatch without a Suspense boundary, discarding and rebuilding the entire root DOM.
production_failures.mitigation: Render a deterministic UTC fallback during SSR and first client pass, then format locale strings inside useEffect.

production_failures.symptom: Hydration fails only for users with grammar or password-manager extensions
production_failures.root_cause: Mounting the application root directly onto document.body exposes the hydration cursor to extension-injected sibling nodes.
production_failures.mitigation: Mount the application inside a dedicated wrapper element such as <div id="root">.
